title: Malicious code in modelbufs (npm)
description: The npm package modelbufs@1.0.1 contains malicious code in its postinstall hook that collects extensive environment and system information from the installer, encrypts it, and sends it to a hardcoded external server. This data collection is narrowly targeted to a specific private project, making the malicious behavior stealthy and limited to one organization's build systems. The package itself provides no legitimate functionality, acting solely as a reconnaissance tool during installation.
